notes: TROOP 0.4 turns the jungle into a finite, circumnavigable planet with continents, islands, huge oceans and lakes, plains, grasslands, desert, ice, and broad mountain systems whose major summits average about 1,200 m and top out at 6,000 m. A deterministic intercontinental road hierarchy reaches far beyond spawn, while the new smooth world atlas zooms from local satellite detail through live player headings to a rotatable atmospheric globe and detailed lunar atlas in space. A four-monkey rocket opens a complete lunar expedition: a real three-minute outbound flight, launch fire and exhaust, atmosphere departure through stars, planets, constellations, nebulae, and a spiral galaxy, lunar gravity, pressure suits, oxygen and backpack survival, a cheese villager market, admin moon travel, and a faster fiery ocean-splashdown return. Planetary realm, expedition, trade, and crew state use the new protocol v7 multiplayer contract, with bounded map caching and streaming designed to preserve high-speed performance.
